name: @papercliped-engine/worker-daemon
description: The ePaperclip worker daemon: runs on a node you own, keeps an outbound authenticated connection to the host, and executes authorized jobs.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/epaperclip-worker.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __epcRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __epcRequire(import.meta.url);"
